19                THE SECRETARY:   Legislative 

20   Resolution Number 1898, by Senator Gallivan, 

21   honoring Ricky Palermo upon the occasion of his 

22   designation as recipient of a Liberty Medal, the 

23   highest honor bestowed upon an individual by the 

24   New York State Senate.  

25                "WHEREAS, It is incumbent upon the 


                                                                3183

 1   people of the State of New York to recognize and 

 2   acknowledge those within our midst who have made 

 3   significant contributions to the quality of life 

 4   therein; and 

 5                "WHEREAS, From time to time this 

 6   Legislative Body takes note of certain 

 7   extraordinary individuals it wishes to recognize 

 8   for their valued contributions to the success and 

 9   progress of society and publicly acknowledge 

10   their endeavors which have enhanced the basic 

11   humanity among us all; and 

12                "WHEREAS, This Legislative Body is 

13   justly proud to honor Ricky Palermo upon the 

14   occasion of his designation as recipient of a 

15   Liberty Medal, the highest honor bestowed upon an 

16   individual by the New York State Senate; and 

17                "WHEREAS, The New York State Senate 

18   Liberty Medal was established by resolution and 

19   is awarded to individuals who have merited 

20   special commendation for exceptional, heroic, or 

21   humanitarian acts on behalf of their fellow 

22   New Yorkers; and 

23                "WHEREAS, A native of Batavia, 

24   New York, Ricky Palermo was involved in an  

25   automobile accident in 1981, which injured his 


                                                                3184

 1   spinal cord and left him paralyzed from the chest 

 2   down; and 

 3                "WHEREAS, With the support of family 

 4   and friends, Ricky Palermo started an annual golf 

 5   tournament in an effort to raise awareness and 

 6   funding for people with spinal cord injuries; and 

 7                "WHEREAS, For the past 17 years, the 

 8   Ricky Palermo Spinal Injury Golf Tournament has 

 9   donated significant funds in support of research  

10   and further care for those with this affliction; 

11   and 

12                "WHEREAS, This year's 18th Annual 

13   Palermo Golf Tournament and Dinner will be held 

14   on Saturday, August 2, 2015; other events taking  

15   place throughout the year include a lacrosse 

16   clinic, as well as a soccer and basketball 

17   clinic; and 

18                "WHEREAS, An avid sports fan, Ricky  

19   Palermo played soccer, basketball, and football 

20   at Byron Bergen High School; he was named Most 

21   Valuable Player in each of these sports, and is a 

22   recipient of his school's Athlete of the Year 

23   Award; and 

24                "WHEREAS, Throughout the entire 

25   period of his community service, a period of 


                                                                3185

 1   constructive involvement, Ricky Palermo has stood 

 2   constant in dignity, good grace and humor; and 

 3                "WHEREAS, With him throughout have 

 4   been his parents, Virginia and Pat, his brother, 

 5   Jim (Nancy), his sister, Patty (Joe), and his  

 6   three nieces, Jamie, Amy, and Annie, all of whom 

 7   feel privileged to be a part of his life and 

 8   rejoice in his achievements; and 

 9                "WHEREAS, Individuals and 

10   organizations devoted to improving the quality of 

11   life for others, enabling them to build lives of 

12   dignity and self-worth, are deserving of the 

13   highest praise and recognition; now, therefore, 

14   be it 

15                "RESOLVED, That this Legislative 

16   Body pause in its deliberations to honor Ricky 

17   Palermo upon the occasion of his designation as 

18   recipient of a Liberty Medal, the highest honor 

19   bestowed upon an individual by the New York State 

20   Senate; and be it further 

21                "RESOLVED, That a copy of this  

22   resolution, suitably engrossed, be transmitted to 

23   Ricky Palermo."

24                ACTING PRESIDENT FUNKE:   Senator 

25   Gallivan.


                                                                3186

 1                SENATOR GALLIVAN:   Thank you, 

 2   Mr. President.

 3                I rise to thank my colleagues for 

 4   bestowing the Liberty Medal upon my lifelong 

 5   friend Ricky Palermo.  

 6                You've heard some of his 

 7   accomplishments, and it really is a testament to 

 8   him and his family that following his injury in 

 9   1981 that he has dedicated himself over 30 years 

10   now to trying to do something about it and to 

11   help others.

12                Through his efforts, he's raised 

13   over a million dollars to benefit spinal cord 

14   research, in particular supporting the Miami 

15   Project to Cure Paralysis that was developed back 

16   in the mid-'80s when Marc Buoniconti, son of 

17   Miami Dolphins Hall of Famer Nick Buoniconti, was 

18   injured and ultimately founded the Miami Project 

19   to Cure Paralysis to find a cure for paralysis.

20                Not much was known in the 1980s 

21   about spinal cord injuries.  There was almost no 

22   hope then.  And Ricky continued, with others, to 

23   persevere, the doctors did their work, and now 

24   there is hope.  Along with the FDA's recent 

25   approval, doctors at the Miami Project have now 


                                                                3187

 1   actually started doing human clinical trials for 

 2   both those with acute spinal cord injuries and 

 3   chronic injuries like Ricky has.

 4                Rick is now trying to make people 

 5   aware of these clinical trials in an effort to 

 6   help those individuals and families that suffer 

 7   these injuries, and he becomes available to any 

 8   member to help with the emergency rooms, the 

 9   trauma doctors in your particular district, to 

10   help make families aware that this is something 

11   that can exist and benefit them.

12                And in addition to that, he has 

13   worked with the YMCA and started a bike program 

14   to help those with spinal cord neurological 

15   injuries, and again is available for anybody with 

16   the YMCA who has an interest in developing this 

17   program.

18                He is an incredible person, coming 

19   from an incredible family.  He's here today with 

20   his brother Jim, another lifelong friend, and a 

21   friend, Sam from Batavia, and his nurse Jackie.  

22                And he truly is an inspiration to 

23   many, many people who continue to stand with him 

24   to try to do something about spinal cord 

25   injuries.  And because, in part, of his efforts 


                                                                3188

 1   and so many others, there actually is hope on the 

 2   horizon.  

 3                And I thank you for your efforts.  

 4   I'm thrilled that you're here with us today.  And 

 5   I thank my colleagues again for recognizing Ricky 

 6   with a Liberty Medal.  

 7                Thank you, Mr. President.

 8                ACTING PRESIDENT FUNKE:   Thank you, 

 9   Senator Gallivan.  

10                Rick, you and your family have been 

11   friends of mine, extended relatives.  In all 

12   transparency, your sister is my sister-in-law.  

13                We all salute your perseverance.  We 

14   all salute your grace in the face of enormous 

15   adversity all these years, Rick.  And we thank 

16   you for setting such a great example for all of 

17   us.  

18                On behalf of the entire State 

19   Senate, we thank you for all you do and for 

20   turning a tragedy into a triumph.  On behalf of 

21   the New York State Senate, we extend the 

22   gratitude of the entire Senate to you and your 

23   family.
